llm.summary: This skill runs local healthcare table checks and does not show hidden networking, persistence, data exfiltration, or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill may process sensitive healthcare and financial table data, but the inspected code runs locally, uses no network APIs, and reads only the manifest, local engines, and optional user-selected input file.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No package install, dependency fetch, remote payload, or setup hook was found; the shipped scripts use local files already in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to local Node commands for listing, sampling, routing, and checking user-supplied tables; the skill says not to conclude when input is missing or ambiguous.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No file writes, background workers, scheduled tasks, credential access, environment-variable reads, privilege escalation, or persistent state changes were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The declared purpose, manifest, CLI router, and eight local subskill engines align around healthcare/medical reconciliation checks, with explicit scope limits and out-of-scope warnings.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use this only for locally checking healthcare or medical-finance tables you choose to provide. Treat results as reproducible table-level checks, not legal, medical, billing, or regulatory advice; review the reported scope, skipped checks, and out-of-scope notes before relying on any conclusion.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: Downgraded after inspection: SKILL.md, expert-manifest.json, --list output, and the engine files all show eight declared subskills, and outputs include executed checks, non-run checks, and out-of-scope limits.
[AE1] expected: Not sustained: scripts/run.mjs is present and inspected; it loads the local manifest and local engine files and reads an optional user-specified input file.
[LP1] unexpected: Not sustained: the process.env reference appears only in comments stating that environment variables are not read; no actual environment-variable access was found.
[SDI-1] expected: Not sustained: medical-device traceability is explicitly listed in SKILL.md, tags, the manifest, and the CLI list output as one of the eight subskills.
[SQP-1] expected: Partially supported as a quality consideration: some generic Chinese routing keywords are present, but dispatch primarily scores table headers and refuses tied or unmatched routing, with no hidden authority or data movement.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only interface is consistent with the skill's Chinese healthcare compliance domain and is plainly visible in the name, descriptions, documentation, and output strings.
